 PlayStation Plus Premium December 2026 Game Revealed Early
 November 18, 2026 
 By
 Zarmena Khan 
 In case you missed it, Sony has already confirmed a PS Plus Premium December 2026 classic game for the PS5 and PS4. In early September, it was announced that 2002’s PS2 game Ratchet and Clank will be joining the catalog later this year. With only December left, the Insomniac Games platformer will be one of (if not the only) Premium classics.
 When will the PS Plus Premium December 2026 game Ratchet and Clank join the catalog?
 December’s PS Plus Extra and Premium catalogs will be updated on Tuesday, the 15th. Although Sony staggers the catalog by region, classics have all been released globally on the same date thus far. Therefore, we expect Ratchet and Clank to be added to the Premium catalog on December 15.
 On the same date, the game should be available as a stand-alone purchase on the PS Store. Emulated classics are typically available on both the PS5 and PS4.
 Ratchet and Clank was previously remastered for the PS4 in 2016 . The game is currently $9.99 on the PS Store .
 “Ratchet & Clank takes a deeper look at the characters’ origin stories and modernizes the original gameplay,” an official overview reads. “Featuring several new planets, all-new bosses, new Clank gameplay, new flight sequences, and much more — with completely new visuals constructed to use the power of the PS4.”
